declare @q nvarchar(max), @text nvarchar(max), @VoucherCode varchar(3) select @text = [text] from @k
set @text = replace(@text, char(255), char(254))
select a.*, b.ma_hd into #d from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@text, ',') a left join wrkgl b on 1 = 0
update #d set ma_hd = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 1, char(254))
select 1, '' return

declare @q nvarchar(max), @text nvarchar(max) select @text = [text] from @k
set @text = replace(@text, char(255), char(254))
select a.*, b.ma_hd into #d from dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$Split(@text, ',') a left join wrkgl b on 1 = 0
update #d set ma_hd = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$GetWordNum(data, 1, char(254))
create index ma_hd on #d(ma_hd)
update dmhd set _1thanh_ly = @thanh_ly, ngay_tl = @ngay_tl, user_id2 = @@userID, datetime2 = getdate() from dmhd a where (loai_hd2 = '2' and exists(select 1 from #d where ma_hd = a.ma_hd)) or (loai_hd2 = '1' and exists(select 1 from #d where ma_hd = a._1so_hd)) update dmhd set _2thanh_ly = @thanh_ly, _2ngay_tl = @ngay_tl, user_id2 = @@userID, datetime2 = getdate() from dmhd a where (loai_hd2 = '3' and exists(select 1 from #d where ma_hd = a.ma_hd)) or (loai_hd2 = '1' and exists(select 1 from #d where ma_hd = a._2so_hd))
select '' as array$, * from #d order by id return
